issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 06 requires selecting Gemeinden with more than 100,000 male and more than 100,000 female inhabitants, but the reference solution uses a threshold of 10,000 (einwohner_m > 10000 AND einwohner_w > 10000). This numeric threshold mismatch will confuse students about the correct condition and cause discrepancies between expected results and the solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the numeric threshold between problem statement, template, and solution. Update solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql to use the intended threshold: WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000. Alternatively, if the intended threshold is 10,000, correct the problem statement to state 10.000 instead of 100.000. Also consider adding a brief hint in template/aufgabe06.sql showing the intended condition so students are not misled.
